title: 第13章 坊市第14章 赌石
content_zh:
陆家四房都有自己的别院，每处别院占地数千平，刚从陆宸那出来，陆狂就被陆毅拉到了客厅。
刚进客厅，陆狂就一脸不悦道：“三哥，你怎么回事啊，什么都由着宸儿，也不知道劝劝他。”
陆毅给陆狂递上一杯茶，笑着道：“四弟，你别急啊，先听三哥说，听完再生气也不迟啊。”
陆狂觉得三哥这么聪明，他能想到的事，他肯定也想到了，于是从陆毅手里接过茶水，一屁股坐了下来。
陆狂瞪着眼睛道：“三哥，你今天要是不给我一个满意的说法，我跟你没完。”
“你咋个没完？”陆毅笑问道。
陆狂想了一圈，也没想到“对付”陆毅的办法，最后只能恶狠狠的说道：“我今天就不走了。”
陆毅笑道：“不走正好，留下来给我解解闷。”
说着，陆毅从容的坐了下来，认真的说道：“四弟，我之所以由着宸儿，是因为我怀疑宸儿身后站着一个高人。”
闻言，陆狂眼神一亮，凑近陆毅道：“三哥，你说给宸儿重塑丹田和经脉的强者还没有走？”
“我估计是了，要不然宸儿不会不要我的灵晶，更不会在吃了一次亏的情况下还不选择低调行事。”陆毅道。
“哎，三哥，还别说，真的是有这种可能。”仔细想了一下，陆狂认同了陆毅的这种猜测。
“而且，不知为何，我觉得前些时间三大家族商铺被洗劫也是宸儿身后那个人干的。”陆毅又道。
一听这话，陆狂一拍桌子，激动道：“三哥，肯定是这样，要不然那人不会放过我们陆家。”
“对啊，他看似洗劫了四大家族，实则唯独没有动陆家，多半是因为宸儿的关系了。”陆毅道。
想到对方能够拿出续脉丹和大还原丹，陆狂道：“三哥，对方能救宸儿，必然也能救你，要不我们和宸儿说说，让他也帮你重塑经脉和丹田？”
一听这话，陆毅严肃道：“四弟，切莫这样。”
陆狂不解道：“三哥，怎么不行了，如果你也重塑经脉和丹田了，那我们报仇就更有希望了。”
陆毅道：“四弟，宸儿背后的高人能救宸儿，这已是大恩，我们不能贪心，免得惹得人家不悦。”
“好吧！”陆狂失落的点了点头。

陆毅道：“四弟，我现在什么都不想，只要宸儿背后的高人能保护宸儿，我就已经满足了。”
陆狂道：“对方能拿出五六品的丹药，至少也是武皇级的强者，保护宸儿必然不在话下。”
陆毅也是这么想的，之后，两人又聊了一会，陆狂再无半点担忧，开心的带着陆战离开了。
另一边
出了陆家，陆宸施展凌霄步朝着天元城西门方向走去。
因为这几天陆宸忙着挖灵晶，天元城“安全”了很多，到了白天，整座天元城显得格外热闹。
穿过四大家族商业覆盖的区域，陆宸来到了西区中心，进入了天元城最繁华的地段。
众所周知，天元城最繁华的地段只有一座万宝楼不属于城主府产业，其它所有人的产业都是城主府的。
来到西区中心后，陆宸根据上一任的记忆绕了两条街，然后走进了天元城最大的一处坊市。
这座坊市很大，占地数十亩，和外面不同，这里没有商铺，有的只是一个又一个的地摊。
而且，这些地摊售卖的东西也是五花八门，但都是武者需要的东西，看上去非常杂乱。
此外，由于售卖的东西价值不菲，这些摊主的实力都不弱，不少摊主更是像陆宸一样把自己包得严严实实的。
陆宸来这里，其实是通过上一任的记忆知道有这么一个地方，现在有了钱，所以想来这里碰碰运气。
进入坊市后，陆宸发现不仅摊主多，来逛坊市的人也不少，还都是一些实力不弱的武者。
简单的扫了一眼，陆宸看出这里售卖的东西绝大部分都是假货，不能买，买了就是上智商税。
“走过路过，千万不能错过，我这里有一把祖传火焰刀，现在只需一百块灵晶，买到就是赚到。”
“客官，我这是一个四阶火风鸟的兽核，您若是买了，武道最少提升两个境界，只卖五十块灵晶。”
“哎呀，客官，你别走呀，如果五十觉得贵，四十也是可以商量的。”
“客官，……”
“……”

在各种嘈杂的叫卖声中，陆宸悄悄的释放出了魂力，一个一个摊子认真的感知了起来。
“嘿，没想到天元城这种小地方居然还有这玩意，真是惊喜啊！”
看了一刻钟，一个摊子吸引了陆宸的注意，陆宸眼前一亮，不紧不慢的朝着摊子走了过去。
content_en:
Each of the four rooms in the Lu family has its own separate courtyard, each of which covers an area of ​​several thousand square meters. As soon as Lu Kuang came out of Lu Chen's place, Lu Kuang was pulled into the living room by Lu Yi.
As soon as he entered the living room, Lu Kuang said with a displeased look on his face: "Third brother, what's wrong with you? Chen'er does everything up to him and doesn't know how to persuade him."
Lu Yi handed Lu Kuang a cup of tea and said with a smile: "Fourth brother, don't be impatient. Listen to what Third Brother has to say first. It's not too late to get angry after listening."
Lu Kuang felt that the third brother was so smart, he must have thought of everything he could think of, so he took the tea from Lu Yi and sat down.
Lu Kuang stared and said, "Third brother, if you don't give me a satisfactory explanation today, I'm not done with you."
"Why are you still here?" Lu Yi asked with a smile.
Lu Kuang thought for a while, but couldn't think of a way to "deal with" Lu Yi. In the end, he could only say viciously: "I won't leave today."
Lu Yi smiled and said: "It's better if you don't leave. You can stay and relieve my boredom."
With that said, Lu Yi sat down calmly and said seriously: "Fourth brother, the reason why I let Chen'er go is because I suspect that there is an expert standing behind Chen'er."
Hearing this, Lu Kuang's eyes lit up and he approached Lu Yi and said, "Third brother, you said that the strong man who reshaped Chen'er's Dantian and meridians has not left yet?"
"I guess so, otherwise Chen'er wouldn't have wanted my spiritual crystal, and wouldn't have chosen to keep a low profile even after suffering a loss." Lu Yi said.
"Hey, third brother, don't mention it, it's really possible." After thinking about it carefully, Lu Kuang agreed with Lu Yi's guess.
"And, for some reason, I feel that the person behind Chen'er who ransacked the shops of the three major families a while ago was also responsible." Lu Yi added.
Upon hearing this, Lu Kuang slapped the table and said excitedly: "Third brother, this must be the case, otherwise that person would not let our Lu family go."
"Yes, he seemed to have robbed the four major families, but in fact he was the only one who left the Lu family alone. It was probably because of Chen'er," Lu Yi said.
Thinking that the other party could produce the Meridian Renewal Pill and the Great Restoration Pill, Lu Kuang said: "Third Brother, if the other party can save Chen'er, he will definitely be able to save you. How about we talk to Chen'er and let him help you reshape your meridians and Dantian?"
Upon hearing this, Lu Yi said seriously: "Fourth brother, please don't do this."
Lu Kuang said in confusion: "Third brother, why is it not working? If you can also reshape your meridians and Dantian, then we will have more hope for revenge."
Lu Yi said: "Fourth brother, the master behind Chen'er can save Chen'er. This is a great favor. We can't be greedy, lest we make others unhappy."
"Okay!" Lu Kuang nodded disappointedly.
Lu Yi said: "Fourth brother, I don't think about anything now. As long as the master behind Chen'er can protect Chen'er, I will be satisfied."
Lu Kuang said: "The opponent can produce fifth- and sixth-grade elixirs, and he is at least a Martial Emperor-level expert. Protecting Chen'er will be no problem."
Lu Yi thought so too. After that, the two chatted for a while. Lu Kuang was no longer worried at all and happily took Lu Zhan away.
other side
After leaving the Lu family, Lu Chen used Ling Xiaobu and walked toward the west gate of Tianyuan City.
Because Lu Chen was busy digging for spiritual crystals these days, Tianyuan City was much "safer". During the day, the entire Tianyuan City seemed particularly lively.
After passing through the business area covered by the four major families, Lu Chen came to the center of the West District and entered the most prosperous area of ​​Tianyuan City.
As we all know, there is only one Wanbao Tower in the most prosperous area of ​​Tianyuan City that does not belong to the property of the City Lord's Mansion. Everyone else's properties belong to the City Lord's Mansion.
After arriving at the center of the West District, Lu Chen walked around two streets based on the memory of his predecessor, and then walked into the largest square market in Tianyuan City.
This market is very large, covering an area of ​​dozens of acres. Unlike outside, there are no shops here, just stalls one after another.
Moreover, these stalls sell a variety of things, but they are all things that warriors need, and they look very messy.
In addition, since the items soldThe food is worth a lot of money, and these stall owners are not weak in strength, and many of them are as tight-knit as Lu Chen.
Lu Chen came here because he knew there was such a place through the memory of his previous job. Now that he had money, he wanted to try his luck here.
After entering Fangshi, Lu Chen found that not only were there many stall owners, but also many people came to visit Fangshi, and they were all quite powerful warriors.
After a simple glance, Lu Chen saw that most of the things sold here were fake and could not be bought. If you buy them, you will be charged IQ tax.
"Don't miss it if you pass by. I have an ancestral flame knife here. Now it only costs one hundred spiritual crystals. If you buy it, you will make money."
"Sir, this is the beast core of a fourth-level fire wind bird. If you buy it, your martial arts will be improved by at least two realms. It only costs fifty pieces of spiritual crystals."
"Oh, sir, please don't leave. If fifty feels too expensive, forty is negotiable."
"Guest sir,..."
"..."
Amidst the noisy hawking sounds, Lu Chen quietly released his soul power and carefully sensed each stall.
"Hey, I didn't expect that a small place like Tianyuan City would have something like this. What a surprise!"
After looking at it for a quarter of an hour, a stall caught Lu Chen's attention. Lu Chen's eyes lit up and he walked towards the stall unhurriedly.
